# RouteKit

A small warehouse manifest CLI. Run from the repository root:

    python3 -B -m routekit.cli manifest "North Dock"

Expected zone-key behavior is in docs/behavior.md. Run all tests with:

    python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v

The package also formats the zone labels used on shipment stickers.
===ZONES===
"""Shared zone-key normalization."""


def canonical_zone(value):
    return value.strip().lower()
===LABELS===
"""Format the zone label printed on a shipment sticker."""
from routekit.zones import canonical_zone


def zone_label(zone):
    return "zone:" + canonical_zone(zone)
===MANIFEST===
"""Build the payload consumed by the dispatch system."""
from routekit.zones import canonical_zone


def build_manifest(zone):
    return {"zone_key": canonical_zone(zone)}
===CLI===
"""Command-line entry point for warehouse manifests."""
import argparse
import json
from routekit.manifest import build_manifest


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="routekit")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    manifest = commands.add_parser("manifest")
    manifest.add_argument("zone")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    print(json.dumps(build_manifest(args.zone), sort_keys=True))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
===INIT===
